summary: decompose god function main in uri2koru cli

delivery.outcome: Decompose main in packages/uri2koru/src/uri2koru/cli.py (PLF-037): extract _add_decode/_add_run/_add_resolve subcommand registrars and a _build_parser assembly so the argparse construction leaves main, and route each dispatched subcommand through _cmd_decode/_cmd_run/_cmd_resolve handlers, dropping main from CC=12 / fan-out=16 / mutations=19 to CC=4 / fan-out=5 / mutations=1 (god-function thresholds: fan-out > 10, mutations > 6, CC > 12) with every new helper under the same thresholds, while keeping the public main(argv)->int contract, the uri2koru console-script binding and byte-identical stdout/stderr/exit-code behavior for all three subcommands.
nonGoals: Reducing the pre-existing god function nlp2uri in packages/uri2koru/src/uri2koru/nlp2uri.py (untouched by this ticket)
Changing subcommand names, flags, defaults, help texts or output formatting
Extracting cli.py into a new module or package

architecture.decision: Split the argparse construction into per-subcommand registrars (_add_decode, _add_run, _add_resolve) because code2llm counts each add_* method call as a mutation, so a single _build_parser would keep 16 mutations and remain a god function; each registrar holds at most 5 mutations. Dispatch handlers stay in cli.py and call the module-level uri_to_dsl/run_uri/nlp2uri imports directly so existing uri2koru.cli patch targets keep working (late binding through the module facade).
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit to restore the single inline main function.

commands: python3 -c "from code2llm.api import analyze; r = analyze('packages/uri2koru/src'); print([(s.name, s.line) for s in r.smells if s.file.endswith('cli.py')]); print({k: v for k, v in r.metrics.items() if k.endswith('cli.main')})"
validation.evidence: The code2llm smell list contains no function defined in cli.py and cli.main reports CC=4, fan-out=5, below every god-function threshold.
All existing uri2koru tests pass unchanged plus new main() dispatch regression tests covering decode, run (text and --json), resolve (text and --json) and the unknown-command exit path.
Governance gate passes with 0 errors from the ticket worktree.
